An edit in the strategy says to drop the 15th Timer Mine for 'the 4th marker' (Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker)); the list is kept as published with 15 Timer Mines.
Byline 'Ghost "Ghetto 6" Face' reads as a joke name (Ghostface); credited by the DeckTech handle Ghetto 6 as plain text, as with deck 17987.
Posted 'Dagobah' dested Dagobah (Light); 'Hoth Main Power Generators' dested Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker).
No Coruscant-set cards are listed, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
